title: Prove complete-chart child packet volume and isolate the whole-job adapter gap
body:
## Summary

```text
complete family/cover packet
  -> row and affine chart bijection
  -> one rank-(r floor(e/73)) child, volume V/(W Gamma)
  -> Gamma H_r jobs have normalized volume H_r/W
```

Proves the complete-address volume identity needed by COMPLEX.md's stopped-recursion premise N(iii), with every inactive axis, remainder, fresh row, compact field, suffix, prefix and return label retained. Binds all seven paid bins to the actual mixed dispatch and four scalar provider reports/receipts, while inheriting the original residual fill contract. The actual uniform whole-job pack/unpack adapter remains an explicit implementation gap; N(i) remains separate. No new kappa.

## Evidence

- **Before:** COMPLEX.md asserts the child volume; the scalar native producer exposes ranks and monomial factors but no complete node-level request adapter.
- **After:** Written all-size conditional address lemma; source authentication and seven-bin reconciliation; 2044 exact volume/stock cases, two exhaustive 2048-address affine fixtures and eleven rejection controls pass normally and under `-O`. Registered metadata/pin check and replay take 0.58 s and 0.62 s locally.
- Exact commands and environment are recorded in `research/complex-child-packet-volume/VALIDATION.json`. No full owner-fill, native, Gamma-cover, moment-root or physical-tape replay ran.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** research

One isolated package; predecessor sources and the selected frontier are unchanged. This scoped result does not establish physical N(iii) acceptance or the full multiplication theorem. Credit is preserved for Cinna Davis, unpaidmoon, Matarener and the native/compiler/hosting predecessors; prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
